reviews.text: Congratulations to the team at Avda. de los Toreros, including the groomers Andrea and Ana, for their kindness and care towards my Spanish Water Dog. Ana gave him a haircut today and we were both thrilled. Thank you so much!
Fran, it's a pleasure to see your positive review. We really appreciate you taking the time to leave us your five stars. We hope to continue to meet your expectations every time you visit us.
I loved the service. Ana was wonderful. Very kind and super sweet with Inka, my dog ​​❤️
The best thing is the service; they're great professionals. The store is always tidy and clean.
Ana is an excellent dog groomer. She made Maxito look very handsome. Thank you so much.

We were very happy with the service from Patricia and the store team. Thor came out looking very handsome and happy after his bath and haircut. Thanks to Patricia's patience, Thor will definitely be back.

Fantastic location and excellent service!!!
Jeni served me and it only made me want to come back even more.

Excellent store, very well organized and with outstanding service.
100% recommended.
Borja helped us and he was fantastic, very professional and attentive.
Lucia assisted me and was very competent and kind.
Excellent service, a 10 out of 10. Thank you. Jennifer Borja and Belen were very kind; we will definitely return.
Jennifer and Borja are amazing. They always give me advice on nutrition and walks. You have to give them a raise ❤️❤️❤️
My experience at Avenida de los Toreros was excellent. Laura is lovely and helped me every step of the way.
Thank you so much Belen for your attention, you were super kind and very attentive.

I bought a 7kg bag of salmon-flavored cat food. I always buy my cats' food here at the market. When I got home and opened the bag, I noticed a very strong smell. I called to ask if they would replace it, and the response was that the salmon food always has that strong smell, even though I've been buying that same bag of food for years and it's never smelled like that before. I thought they might be right, because a few days later my cats started vomiting. My vet recommended, without me even asking, that I change the food to see what might be causing the vomiting, and they are indeed better now. By not replacing a product that was probably opened and spoiled without them noticing, they lost a customer who spends €100 or more every six weeks at the market for his cats. Now, even though it's far away, I go somewhere else.

Danilo, we greatly appreciate the time you've taken to evaluate our work. Your support motivates us to continue providing quality service for you and all animal lovers. We hope to always have your trust.

Good morning, we visited the store for the first time yesterday. This summer we found an abandoned kitten, just 8 days old. We'd never had a cat before, so of course, we needed a lot of advice. Belén, one of the sales assistants, treated us wonderfully. She was lovely and shared her cat-related experiences with us, offering advice and opening the store doors to answer any questions we had.

Thank you, Belén, and the other staff members. You are the kind of people who make the world a better place. Thank you again!

Definitely a fantastic find when we were new to the neighborhood. The staff are lovely with both customers and dogs! You can tell they love furry friends! And that's so appreciated. They answer any questions you might have, the prices are great, and they often have very attractive offers. They also offer home delivery if you'd like. My big little dog and I are regular customers!
I always buy everything for my pets, cats and dog, here. Lucía and Borja's service is wonderful, and that's what makes me loyal to the store. Plus, they do home deliveries, which is great!
Kiwoko is wonderful, I always find what I need there.

We just adopted a kitten and we're total newbies. We went to buy everything we needed to pick her up tomorrow and Fer was fantastic. We bought everything we needed and she gave us lots of advice on care and feeding. It's a shame we're just passing through because if we lived in Madrid, this would be our go-to place ❤️

Excellent service. The staff were incredibly friendly. In this case, Lucia helped me; she gave me advice, found the product I needed, and even gave me the address. Thanks to the Kiwoko team, I will definitely be back.

We sincerely appreciate you taking the time to rate us, Jose Luis. It's heartwarming to know your experience at Kiwoko was positive. We hope to continue being your trusted place for all your pet's needs.

I want to leave this review especially for Ana, because I believe people like her make a huge difference.

I've had quite a few problems with the Kiwoko website before, but every time I go to this store, I leave with a completely different experience thanks to the service I receive. Ana, in particular, has demonstrated a professionalism, warmth, and dedication that go far beyond what one expects.

Thank you for your kindness, your professionalism, and for showing that behind great service there can also be a big heart. I wish everyone who works in customer service treated people with the same dedication and care. 🥰
As always, I'm delighted to shop at Kiwoko on Avenida de Los Toreros. Ever since Baco, our larder, was born, Borja has been providing us with excellent service. 100% recommended!
Expert people with a wide variety of products and services.

There are professionals who do their job very well, and then there are the people who are truly dedicated. Borja is one of them.

He's been advising me on the diet of Hadda, my French bulldog, for some time now, and thanks to his knowledge, follow-up, and dedication, her atopic allergies are much better controlled. What I value most is the peace of mind I get from knowing he's always looking out for her.

Hadda is a very important part of my life, and that's why I'm so grateful to have found someone who cares for her with such professionalism and compassion.

Thank you, Borja, for your commitment and for helping me give Hadda a better quality of life. It's a pleasure to have you on board.
Excellent service from Borja and Belen

It's a real pleasure to receive such a positive review, Laura. Your support is essential for us to continue offering the best to the families of our furry friends. We hope to remain your trusted store for all your pet needs.
The best place for your furry son, thank you for always advising me on the best, thank you so much Borja
Fantastic service, they have everything for our four-legged baby
Amazing service.
Great, super attentive and answered all my questions, especially Lucía and Jennifer, a 10 out of 10 for both of them

The best pet store in Madrid! I've been shopping here for over 10 years (back when they were Telepiensos). The store is always spotless, the staff are very friendly and knowledgeable about the products. Special mention for Borja; he couldn't be kinder or more helpful. He assists and advises you on everything you need—an absolute 10, both professionally and personally.
Efficient, huge warehouse, I requested a cat grooming service, very limited, and they confirmed it the next day

100% recommended. The shop is very pleasant, and the staff, especially Borja, were incredibly helpful in finding the product I needed. He even called another store to arrange it. They were always attentive and focused on providing the best customer service.

The service at this Kiwoko store is fantastic. It's nothing like the ones in shopping malls that seem to be trying to take over the company. At the Avenida de los Toreros location, they care about people and pets.
How thoughtful of you, Marta, to receive such a positive review. We're delighted to hear you enjoyed your experience. We hope to see you again very soon at Kiwoko.

Evita, it's always a pleasure to hear that your experience at Kiwoko was positive. Your feedback motivates us and encourages us to continue paying attention to every detail. Best regards, and we hope to see you again very soon at Mundo Animal.

Sara, it's a real pleasure to receive such positive feedback from our customers. We greatly appreciate your trust in our team and our services. We will continue working to remain your go-to store for everything you need for your animals' well-being.

I'm very grateful for the service I received from Lucía and Borja. I was completely lost, and they gave me excellent advice with great patience. The shop has a wide selection at very competitive prices. I definitely recommend it.

I'd like to thank the entire team at Kiwoko Avda de los Toreros for their excellent service, the speed with which they processed home deliveries, and their friendliness. A special thanks also to the delivery drivers, who are the fastest and most efficient. Thank you so much!
Isabel from Moratalaz
Very kind
Jennifer and Lucía provided excellent service. They answered all our questions very well.
Many thanks to Ana and Lucia for their help in finding everything we need to keep our dog Besos, our cat Balto, and especially all the little birds that come to eat on the terrace happy!!
Very fast shipping, wide variety of options, and they advise you on everything you need.
The staff are very friendly and helpful. They always help you choose the most suitable product for your pet. They also offer ongoing promotions and member discounts.

My favorite place to buy everything I need for my pet. I loved the personalized attention from the girls who were there. Honestly, I went in without any prior knowledge, and they kindly recommended several options for my puppy. It's a bit far from my house, but it's worth going to this branch because they have tons of things, options, and the service is top-notch.
A wide variety of pet products and excellent customer service. Especially the staff who have been working there longer; they always offer advice and help with great professionalism and kindness.
Ana and Belen have been wonderful to me. Thank you so much for the advice!
As always, the service I received from the store staff was excellent. They are very friendly and professional, and they gave me perfect advice on which option was best for my dog.
Good service and friendly, everything you need at a good price.

What a joy to receive such a positive review! Ana Paula, your support is crucial to us and encourages us to keep going. We hope you continue to enjoy your visits to Kiwoko, where you'll always find the best for your pets.
I highly recommend this store over all the others in the same company. The staff are incredibly helpful. They always resolve my issues. Attentive, friendly, and professional. 10 out of 10.

I used to go to the Kiwoko in the Goya area, but it's getting worse and worse. The new staff they've hired are neither helpful nor willing to assist; you can be left waiting to be charged for minutes while they finish their private conversation. That's why I now go to the one on Avenida de los Toreros, where the women are lovely. They're always ready to help when you have a problem. Even though it's a bit of a trek, it's worth it. I hope the people in Goya change their attitude.

Laura, receiving such a positive review is truly important to our entire team. We want every visit to Kiwoko to be a pleasant one for you and your pets. We hope to continue earning your trust for many years to come.

Lucia was very kind and patient with us.
Congratulations on having her as a colleague.
Always great service for my little dog!!
Your feedback is always appreciated and inspires us to continue offering the best. It's a pleasure to know that your experience was positive. We sincerely appreciate your review, Jorge.
Excellent service! They have everything and Borja gave us great advice!
Borja and Ana provided excellent service. The store also has a wide variety of products.
As always, the service was friendly and professional. All the staff are very nice and charming. I'm a regular customer and will continue to be. 💕💕💕💕💕 …
The staff are very helpful; Borja and Ana are two wonderful professionals. It's always a pleasure to shop at this Kiwoko.
When I went, it was closed… I don't know why they advertise it as open until 9:00 PM if they're not going to be there. You arrive and it's closed. (On a Saturday)
Always helping.

I went to the store to buy a few things I needed, and a young lady named Esther helped me.

I can't say enough good things about her; she was incredibly kind and friendly, and she knew exactly what I needed. She was a huge help.

Thank you so much! I'll definitely be back so she can help me with my shopping for my little dog.
I went to get food for a baby kitten and Jennifer gave me very kind advice!
The staff is very attentive and professional.

It's a real pleasure to receive such positive feedback as yours, Normir. We sincerely appreciate you taking the time to rate us with the highest score. We're always here to offer the best for you and your furry companions.
The saleswoman is friendly and helped us a lot. The girl with the "noisy chicken" ;-)
I am very grateful for the attention, advice, and personal warmth. I highly recommend it.
They haven't resolved the issues they're having with the carrier, and the order has never arrived. It's a disgrace after countless complaints.
Borja's service was excellent. He explained very well what would be best for Kenzo based on what I was looking for, since he's a Pomeranian and it's difficult to know what he can eat.
Super friendly and helpful, especially Lucía, we'll definitely be back :)
Excellent service. Pipa loves the cookies.
Very good service and friendliness
Always attentive and ready to find what your pet needs. Plus, they're well-groomed and smiling.
Very friendly and professional. The one on Avenida Toreros is my usual store.

What wonderful news to receive your review, Paola! We're thrilled to know your experience with us was worthy of a perfect score. We hope to see you soon at Kiwoko to continue sharing moments with your pet.

We went to Kiwoko yesterday and the experience was fantastic. Borja and his colleague gave us wonderful service, with immense kindness and dedication. They didn't just try to sell us products, but also provided very professional advice on what our Newfoundland really needed and gave us very helpful recommendations in general. It's great to find places where you can tell they know what they're doing and genuinely care about helping. We will definitely be back. Highly recommended!
My golden retriever Kala and I left the store in a very good mood, Lucia was lovely to us, thank you!
Great staff! Borja is a great professional.
A very good experience and very good professionals, especially Borja. Every time we go, he treats us very well and with his usual friendliness.
I've been coming to this Kiwoko for years and it's by far my favorite. The service is excellent and they almost always have what you need, and if not, they always give you options to order online!

I came looking for food for a sparrow that fell from my roof and injured its leg, and they not only helped me find it but also gave me more advice on how to care for the little bird. I'm very happy with Lucia's help! Thank you!
My go-to shop! Excellent service and always great deals and advice. Thank you so much, Borja, for your help and kindness. See you soon ;)
I love this shop; they're lovely to work with and incredibly professional. Lucía was a huge help to me today. Thank you so much!
Very friendly, they give advice about the food. Free home delivery. Thanks Borja

A feast fit for royalty.

Excellent service.

I have been visiting this store for a long time to buy supplies for my pets, dogs and cats, and the service is very friendly and trustworthy because the employees are very qualified in the topics or questions I ask them.

The service and the person who helped us were appalling. There was a 5 for 4 offer, and the sales assistant didn't mention it. We also have a discount card, and she told us they didn't offer discounts there. We called the company afterward, and they said they would speak with the store.

I took my kitten to the groomer. Andrea took care of us! She was very attentive and sweet with my kitten, and it was a wonderful experience. I will definitely continue taking my kitten there.
I also want to mention that all the staff at the store are very helpful.

Yesterday afternoon, I went to the Toreros store and Lucía was there. My parakeet has a health problem, and Lucía treated me with kindness, professionalism, and patience. They didn't have the products I needed there, but she gave me a note for the Velázquez store where I was able to get them. I'm grateful to Lucía for her excellent service and to Fernando and Jennifer for their friendliness. My congratulations to these two!
Variety for your pet
Excellent service from the whole team. They made everything very easy for me.

I was delighted with my visit to Kiwoko! What I'd highlight most is the staff's attention; you can tell they love animals and they gave me wonderful advice on what my pet needed. They also have an impressive variety of products, from high-end pet food to toys I can't find anywhere else. A special mention goes to the great deals they often have, especially if you're a loyalty club member. I always end up saving a good amount. Highly recommended!
Clean and tidy shop and friendly and attentive staff, Lucis was a delight and helped me understand how flea collars work, very happy.
Excellent service. They give you advice about your pet's diet.
I went to buy canned food for my dog ​​and the shopkeeper BORJA served us kindly and gave us very good information about the food we were buying. THANK YOU for the attention.

The staff were incredibly friendly. A young woman named Lucía answered the phone and couldn't have treated me better. She was kind and approachable, and I'm so grateful for her help with my birds and her patience, especially for the advice and recommendations she gave me. I'll definitely buy everything I need and recommend there in the future. It's the Kiwoko store where she and her colleagues have treated me the best I've ever been. You can tell they love working with animals and they know a ton. Thank you, thank you, and thank you to the whole team! I haven't been treated nearly as wonderfully in other stores as I was in this one. It's a real pleasure.

We went to buy food for our dog, and the shop assistant, Borja, gave us excellent service. We explained our dog's problem, and he advised us on what would be best for her. He was very empathetic, and we left feeling much more cheerful. It's clear he's a professional who knows animals' needs very well and gives great advice.

I give them 5 stars because they always help me with all my questions. Plus, they're incredibly kind. They always treat you well, give good advice, and—something I really appreciate these days—they dedicate as much time as needed. Thanks to Ana and especially to Pablo!
A super organized, clean, and well-stocked shop! Lucía was incredibly kind and recommended the best treats for our dog with food anxiety. A true professional!
Very happy with the products and services received, the home delivery is a great feature
Excellent service from Belén, fast and effective.
A shop with a wide variety of products, very friendly and professional staff, I found everything I needed for my kittens 🐱 with staff like this it's a pleasure to go to the shop. …

Excellent service. I'm a regular customer and it's a pleasure to come to this store on Avenida de los Toreros. Borja and Pablo are incredible professionals; they always help me with whatever I need and it's clear they know what they're talking about. A 10 out of 10 for them.

Thank you very much.
Super happy with the Kiwoko bullfighting workers
The gentleman who helped us was great. He gave us lots of explanations and advice. Super friendly and attentive. And above all, efficient.
They have everything and there are always offers, plus the staff are very professional and friendly and they help you with whatever you need.
Nice place to buy things for pets
I've been shopping at this store for over ten years and the service is always fantastic. Pablo, one of the employees, is incredibly friendly and helpful. It's a pleasure dealing with people like him!
Cans of cat food for 3 euros where in other stores they cost 1.80€
The staff are always friendly and offer helpful advice. It's a pleasure to shop there because it's not as crowded as other, larger Kiwoko stores.
Pablo's service was excellent, he's a delight and helps you a lot with everything you ask him 👏🏼👏🏼 …
Perfect service
My experience with Kiwoco's shipping was fantastic!
We have been buying everything our cats need at this store for several years (food, litter boxes, carriers) and the service has always been fantastic from the whole team.
I've been buying here for years, and the service from Pablo, Ana, and Borja has always been outstanding.
the best pet shop in the neighborhood
Excellent service, always!
The best
The entire team at Avda. De los Toreros is very friendly. Borja has been helping us since we adopted our dog and has always given us great advice.

Home delivery is terrible. You call customer service to complain about an order, and they just tell you they'll talk to the carrier. The order still hasn't arrived after 10 days. When you ask, after many calls, what customer service is for, they just tell you that they'll file a claim with the carrier. They've been laughing and talking amongst themselves as if I weren't listening on the phone. It's not the first time this has happened to me. With my previous order, I waited more than 15 days for the second part to arrive. I have to thank them for being so efficient at losing a customer.

I like Kiwoko:
Pablo has helped me a lot.
Sometimes I need advice and I like to receive personalized and professional service.
I recommend it 👍🏼👍🏼
I went to get some biscuits for my dog ​​and noticed they had a wide variety of products. From beds and toys to food.
They provide top-notch service. Pablo has endless patience.
They have a wide variety of products for both dogs and cats.

Receiving positive feedback from our customers means a lot to our team. We appreciate your 5-star rating, Elo. We look forward to continuing to provide you and your pet with the best service and products.

The staff is incredibly friendly and attentive. Special mention to Pablo, who has helped me on my last few visits, but the rest of the staff are also lovely. They always give excellent advice. Everything is made easy.
You guys are awesome!
Jenny and Pablo were a huge help with our new puppy, Dama. They gave us great advice and were incredibly kind and caring. I'm so glad to have Kiwoko nearby.
We always choose Andrea to cut our dog's hair. Definitely the best results!
We always come to Andrea to get my pet's hair cut; the cut is perfect and the service is wonderful! 100% recommended!
A great place to buy everything your pet needs. The service and help you receive are very helpful.
Lucía treated me very well. Very attentive and pleasant. A pleasure.

Excellent service, they are very friendly and the service is always 100/10!
The home delivery of pet food is great.
The shop is great, the staff are super friendly, especially Andrea from the hair salon, she's a sweetheart 🥰 …
Very nice
They treated me wonderfully! It's becoming my go-to shop. Lucia and Borja helped me!
Very nice and with good recommendations.

Modais, it's a real pleasure to receive such positive feedback as yours. Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with our team. We hope to continue exceeding your expectations with every visit to Kiwoko.
Of all the Kiwoko stores I've been to, this one has definitely received the best service. The entire staff is very friendly and attentive.
The guys at the shop are fantastic!! I always go there to buy canned food for my cats, and they always help me, even though I'm in a wheelchair. A 10 out of 10!

I wanted to leave a review to thank the Kiwoko store for their excellent service.

I want to emphasize that if it weren't for the professionalism and attentiveness of the store staff (especially Pablo), I wouldn't continue shopping at this chain. I've been a regular customer online for over 10 years, and the service and support on their website is more than questionable (lost orders, delays, and constant errors).

In particular, I want to thank Pablo, who was incredibly kind and attentive at all times. He helped me find the canned food I needed for my dog ​​when she had an upset stomach, he made sure to write down my phone number so he could let me know when it arrived, and he always gave me advice with great warmth and professionalism.

It's wonderful to encounter people like him. Without a doubt, personal attention makes all the difference. Thank you so much, Pablo!

The Kiwoko in my neighborhood is always fantastic. I find everything my cats need, and whenever I have questions, Pablo is always happy to help and give me recommendations. Quick and friendly service, I'm very pleased!
Pablo is incredibly kind. He's helped me a lot on other occasions. I recommend the store 100%.

I've been going for over a year now and I couldn't be more grateful. The staff is fantastic, they're all so friendly and dedicated. Pablo is always very attentive, and Ana and the rest of the team are also excellent professionals!
It's wonderful to receive your feedback, Salvador. We truly appreciate you taking the time to give us the highest rating. We're always here to offer the best for you and your pets.
The staff are incredibly professional and lovely. I've been a customer for many years and wouldn't change stores for anything. I'm very happy with the Kiwoko on Avenida de los Toreros.

I recently visited a pet store that completely exceeded my expectations. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was clean, tidy, and very welcoming, both for owners and their pets.

The staff was especially friendly and attentive. Borja helped me, always ready to offer helpful recommendations based on each animal's needs. It's clear they have extensive knowledge of the products they sell, which inspires a lot of confidence.

The variety of items is excellent: from high-quality food to toys, accessories, and hygiene products. They also have options for different types of pets, not just dogs and cats.

Another highlight is the great value for money, along with frequent special offers that make the experience even more enjoyable.

Without a doubt, it's a place I'll return to and would recommend to anyone who wants the best for their pet.

I really like it because it has a variety of products, although a month ago I went and was served by a very unfriendly girl on Avenida de los Toreros, today the experience was different... they have everything but that time she was too rude and I'm a shopkeeper and I have a lot of patience, the fact is that I highly recommend it despite that time, the girl who served me today was not only friendly but efficient and very professional.
My favorite store. Pablo is very friendly and efficient. And the home delivery service is incredibly fast and accommodates the customer's chosen schedule. I highly recommend this place.

Hello, good afternoon. Today I went to make a purchase and was assisted by a young woman and Pablo. The service was very personalized and friendly, and I truly felt at home. Greetings to Pablo and his colleague! My order arrived in perfect condition, and I will be back soon.

Sincerely, Janet
Many thanks to Pablo who explained everything perfectly and helped me a lot
There's a really great guy out there named Pablo, he gives excellent advice!
Excellent service; they gave us great advice on our dog's food. Thanks to Pablo's help, we chose a high-quality kibble.
The staff is much friendlier and more professional than in other stores, like the one in Alcalá, for example. They have a wide range of products. Highly recommended!
This shop has highly recommended products and, above all, excellent advice from the staff. They also have a very convenient home delivery service through Uber. Highly recommended.

We deeply appreciate your five-star rating, Fr4mes. It's a true honor to have customers who value our effort and dedication to animal welfare. We look forward to continuing to provide positive experiences on every visit to Kiwoko.
Very nice and you can find everything
Limited products for birds (there is no standard calamar bones or spray millet)
Everyone who works at the store is incredibly friendly, attentive, and efficient. Pablo and Ana always greet me with a smile, answering any questions I have about my cats.
It has everything but it's a bit pricey
We went to buy some basic cat supplies and left with our hands full. We were so lucky to have Pablo help us; he was very nice and professional.
Perfect service and expert help from Pablo
Fantastic! Pablo and Belén are super kind and attentive. Pablo helps me a lot to understand and know the needs of cats, thank you so much!

The experience was fantastic. Andrea and Pablo treated me incredibly well from the very first moment, with great kindness and professionalism. They're so friendly.
They did a fantastic job on my dog; you can really see the care and love they put into their work. He usually gets very nervous when he leaves the groomer's, but this time he was much calmer. I loved the result, and my dog ​​came out looking perfect.

It's wonderful to receive this kind of attention and professionalism. Thank you so much to Pablo and Andrea for the excellent service and work. I'll definitely be back. 🫶🏻

Águeda, it's a real pleasure to see your 5-star rating. Knowing you had a positive experience with us is the best reward. We're always here to help you with anything you need for your furry friends. Thank you for choosing us!
Large store, well located in the heart of the neighborhood. The service is friendly and helpful, and I always find what I'm looking for. A very well-stocked store.
